_comment: The cast (Phase 2 milestone 3). Six mercenaries at stage 1 (D-066). The orc and the Vampyr are the director's reference pair: their battle numbers stay in data/balance/battle.json fighters (one source of truth), named here by stats_from, and the merc's own stats are laid over them. merc_3 to merc_6 are PLACEHOLDERS: the director authors names, species, roles, stats and gear; nothing here for them is a design. Moves are ids the battle sim knows (move, attack, charge, blood_price). gear_line names the battle classes of the merc's own weapon and armour (Phase 4 P1b; the orc is axe and plate per the vision; the Vampyr's sword and plate are a PLACEHOLDER for the director). Generic gear (D-066) fills the three slots for stats only and never shows on the sprite. Schema: data/schema/mercs.schema.json.

mercs.name: The Orc
mercs.role: Big, bulky and mean. Charges in on pure aggression and relies on his gear to survive.

mercs.name: The Vampyr
mercs.role: A regal dark knight whose bestial nature is barely contained. Spends his own health for combat bonuses, plays cautiously and times his all-ins.
